fields.acceptance: A testscript (run-start-queue.txtar or a new one) with rhiza.daemon.permissionMode set: rhiza run start <cs> --workflow plan --autonomous with no --permission-mode queues the run and the queued start records no mode; rhiza daemon --once then starts it with --permission-mode set to the daemon's setting; with the setting naming a mode the agent rejects, the queued start is refused at queue time and nothing is queued; go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... covers checkAgentSteps getting the daemon's mode
fields.statement: A run start queued for the daemon that names no --permission-mode is checked at queue time with rhiza.daemon.permissionMode standing in for the mode, and is queued with no mode recorded, so the daemon starts it with its own rhiza.daemon.permissionMode as it does its own picks; anything that re-checks a queued run's agent steps before the daemon starts it uses the same stand-in

fields.acceptance: A testscript: with rhiza.daemon.permissionMode unset, rhiza run start <cs> --workflow plan with no --permission-mode fails, its stderr names rhiza.daemon.permissionMode, and nothing is queued; with the setting set, rhiza run start --foreground with no --permission-mode is still refused; the NoMode case in internal/api/run_test.go checks the new message
fields.statement: A run start that names no --permission-mode is still refused when rhiza.daemon.permissionMode is unset or the start is --foreground, and the refusal names rhiza.daemon.permissionMode as a way out next to --permission-mode and the step's permission_mode
